run_create_vasp_inputs: run the CLI to generate VASP input files from a directory of CIF structure files
run_create_vasp_relax_inputs: run the CLI with type relax to generate VASP relaxation input files from CIF files
run_create_vasp_static_inputs: run the CLI with type static to generate VASP static calculation input files from CIF files
create_input_generator: create a RelaxSetGenerator or StaticSetGenerator from incar YAML settings and calculation type
review_create_input_generator: review the create_input_generator function that loads incar YAML and returns a VASP set generator
